note: Data must be the EDGS-initialized copies (points.npz from RoMa correspondences, training views only); edgs-density locates edgs_init.npz by the SHA-256 of the initial means and fails loudly otherwise. '--recipe splatstudio' is REQUIRED (appended after bench.py's --recipe 3dgs; argparse last wins): the 3dgs recipe's knn_log_scales does a [4096,N] cdist and OOMs (61 GiB) on EDGS's 3-7M points; edgs-density restores 3DGS's camera-extent means LR itself. --num-gaussians 10000000 (bench default) keeps all init points (max scene here 4.50M, counter). Compare against baseline3dgs-<base dataset>-30000 (same protocol_id) and paper_results.json (entries duplicated under the -edgs keys). edgs = paper-full (pinv SH init); edgs-nosh = released code = paper ablation 'w/o SH init' (M360 avg 27.80). Paper times include ~2 min init; our init timings are in each scene's edgs_init.json (garden 491 s on a shared A6000). Expect slow training (4M Gaussians from step 1; garden smoke 2k steps 455-765 s on a contended GPU).
